🇲🇽📈 MEXICO SMASHES FDI RECORD — $23.59B IN Q1 2026

Mexico just posted the highest foreign direct investment for any first quarter in history: $23,591 million, up 10.4% year-over-year. Reinvestment surged 33.5% to $22.2B — companies already here are doubling down.

Computer and electrical components — the nearshoring sweet spot — jumped 58.7%. Vehicle manufacturing up 20.4%. Mining up 39.7%. The US alone sent $10.2B. They can downgrade ratings all day — capital flows don't lie.

🌎🇧🇴 BOLIVIA'S NEOLIBERAL PRESIDENT CUTS OWN SALARY 50% AS PROTESTS RAGE

Rodrigo Paz, facing his fourth straight week of worker blockades that have cut off food, fuel, and medicine across Bolivia, just announced a 50% salary cut for himself and his cabinet — down to ~$1,808/month.

The Central Obrera Boliviana, highland farmers, and Evo supporters aren't buying it. Twenty days of road blockades. Critical shortages in hospitals and markets. The Senate just passed a "State of Exception" law. This is what happens when you rip out the social state and offer gestures instead of policy.

🇲🇽⚕️ MEXICO DEPLOYS HEALTH FILTERS FOR WORLD CUP OVER EBOLA OUTBREAK

With the Democratic Republic of Congo's national team set to play in Guadalajara, Sheinbaum ordered epidemiological screening protocols for the 2026 World Cup — "health filters that guarantee they won't infect Mexico."

Not travel bans. Mandatory preventive protocols for delegations from outbreak zones. Health Secretary Kershenobich is overseeing design and implementation. Proactive, not panicked — exactly how a public health system is supposed to work.

🇲🇽🔋 GLOBAL POWERS EYE MEXICO'S CRITICAL MINERAL RESERVES

The US just held a "Summit on Critical Minerals" inviting 54 countries to build supply chains away from China. Mexico holds reserves of 9 minerals on Washington's critical list — copper, silver, zinc, lead, lithium.

Sheinbaum's position: "Critical minerals are not up for negotiation — they are a reserve of the nation." Mexico has the polymetallic profile, the US border, the industrial base. Everyone wants in. Sovereignty means deciding who gets access — and on what terms.

🇲🇽🏗️ CDMX OPENS LARGEST UTOPÍA YET — 100,000 SQM FOR 100,000 RESIDENTS

Brugada inaugurated "Utopía La Heroica" in Venustiano Carranza — 100,000 square meters making it the biggest social infrastructure complex built in CDMX. 266 million pesos invested.

$11-peso meals, laundry, mammograms, psychological care, rehab, arts centers, and the city's first permanent elder care residence for seniors with no support networks. This is what happens when infrastructure is built for the people who actually live in a city.

🇲🇽🎓 MEXICO LAUNCHES PROGRAM TO BRING 16,000+ ACADEMICS HOME

Sheinbaum just announced "Cátedras de la Diáspora Mexicana" — a federal program to reconnect Mexican-born scientists and researchers working abroad with universities back home. There are over 16,000 Mexicans with doctorates doing research in the US alone.

Now they get SNI recognition and annual support to return and teach, mentor students, direct theses. Brain drain reversal, built into the system. Convocatoria opens June 5.

🇲🇽⚽ Mexico preparing epidemiological filters for World Cup — Congo's team plays in Guadalajara amid Ebola outbreak. "There have to be specific sanitary measures worked on with the country of origin — if there's a contagious disease, sanitary filters must guarantee they won't spread it in Mexico." — Claudia Sheinbaum, mañanera May 25 With Congo's squad traveling to Guadalajara, Mexico is coordinating health protocols with the country of origin to ensure safe entry.
